_comment: Example correction map. Each rule is {pat, rep, cs?, why?}. `pat` is a Python regex (case-insensitive unless cs=true). Rules are GUARDED so real words survive. Confirm every rule against real contexts with probe.py before adding it. `why` is documentation only, ignored by apply.py.

rules.why: ASR splits bodhicitta into two English words
'bar do' is the intermediate state, not a bar
common m-for-n mishearing of the honorific
the teacher, not the animal; case-sensitive and guarded so 'Dalai Lama' and real llamas survive. Note: also add a (?<!Dalai ) lookbehind in practice.
Bhutan the country must survive; only correct it when followed by nature/Dakini/mind, where it is really Buddha
